profile.name: ESP32-CAM 串口相机模块
profile.description: 一种基于 ESP32 的嵌入式小型相机模块，可通过串口传输图像并进行基础成像参数设置。适合实验中的低成本实时预览、简单图像采集、装置观察与流程记录。
profile.description_en: A compact embedded camera module based on ESP32 that transmits image data over a serial connection and supports basic imaging parameter adjustment. It is suitable for low-cost live preview, simple image capture, setup observation, and experiment documentation in laboratory environments.

registry.name: Espressif Systems Camera ESP32Cam Serial
registry.description: Camera Esp32 CAM Serial是由Espressif Systems生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、关闭、初始化、启动、日志记录、设备连接。
